set.description: Set the value of the target with the given keys

log.description: Adds a log statement for the given participant.

insert.description: Inserts the value at the given index in the target with the provided keys

get.description: Get the value from the source provided the keys and save in target.

select.description: Selects the next behavior to exhibit.

display.description: Prints the promopt to screen (prompt is an f string)
display.example: display("f'Got book named {name} and it has first letter {firstLetter}'")

isEqual.description: Checks the equality of cmp1 and cmp2 and stores result.

getFromPos.description: Get the value at pos from source and saves it in target.

removeFromPos.description: Removes the value at pos from source and saves it in target.

run.description: Synthesizes the block which runs the desig.
